tools.name: search_anesthesia_jobs
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to discover current public anesthesia jobs by provider role or U.S. state. Returns numbered results with opaque follow-up handles. Do not use it to infer hidden pay or search for clinicians.

tools.name: get_anesthesia_job
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for details about one job already returned by RxRooster search. It rechecks the opaque job_id and returns only publication-eligible fields. Do not use it with guessed IDs or for private listing data.

tools.name: get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet
tools.description: Use this when a recruiter wants branded flyer downloads or factual Facebook-group copy for a currently live public RxRooster anesthesia opening. Accepts an opaque job_id, durable listing URL, or eligible non-single-use live listing alias; rechecks publication eligibility; and returns a portfolio mat

tools.name: explore_coverage_areas
tools.description: Use this when an employer asks where RxRooster shows anonymous public CRNA service options or approximate U.S. coverage. tools.name: prepare_anesthesia_service_draft
tools.description: Use this when a CRNA, SRNA, or anesthesiologist wants to structure their own stated work terms, including an explicit call or no-call preference, for native RxRooster review. The draft is private and non-persistent here. Ask rate visibility neutrally. Do not include identity/contact fields or claim

tools.description: Use this when an employer or recruiter wants to parse an anesthesia job description or structure answers into a privacy-safe, non-persistent requisition draft for native RxRooster review.
